commits.subject: feat(native)!: make Ghidra the sole deep analysis provider
commits.body:
feat(native)!: make Ghidra the sole deep analysis provider

Route deep native CLI and MCP analysis through Ghidra. Remove retired provider adapters, installers, GUI tools, and verification lanes. Keep static inspection and historical Evidence available, and document how to migrate existing registrations.

BREAKING CHANGE: Hopper, IDA, and Kuna no longer provide deep native analysis. Select ghidra or auto and reopen the original executable. Use REA_TARGET_PATH for eager MCP startup.
